ticket_id.description: The ticket reference exactly as written, e.g. ST-4821.

product.description: The device the ticket is about.

severity.description: high: the device is unusable, unsafe or the customer asks for urgency; medium: it works with problems; low: questions, cosmetic issues and returns.

refund_amount.description: The refund the customer asks for, as a plain number, or null if none is requested.
